sections.heading: C2 — Restraint, phone and insurance confusables
sections.markdown:
## C2 — Restraint, phone and insurance confusables with knowledge-graph hints

FACT_ID: sec03-R01 | anchor: A14
Under two years or under thirty pounds means rear facing only, while two to five years or under forty pounds opens the forward facing harnessed seat. [A14]
Why it matters: group_hint infant-tiers; prereq_hint sec03-F20; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec03-F20, sec03-F21.
Source: [A14 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0014]
FACT_ID: sec03-R02 | anchor: A14
Five to eight years or forty to sixty pounds allows a harness or booster, eight plus years with sixty plus pounds allows a booster or plain belt, and split cases always take the stricter seat. [A14]
Why it matters: group_hint child-tiers; prereq_hint sec03-R01; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec03-F21, sec03-R01.
Source: [A14 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0014]
FACT_ID: sec03-R03 | anchor: A14
Airbags guard the wheel, dash and windshield only, so belts stay mandatory for side, rear and rollover blows and for holding the driver behind the wheel. [A14]
Why it matters: group_hint airbag-limits; prereq_hint sec03-F14; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec03-F14, sec03-F19.
Source: [A14 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0014]
FACT_ID: sec03-R04 | anchor: A15
Adults may talk hands free behind the wheel, but sixteen and seventeen year olds may touch no phone or device whatever, hands free included. [A15]
Why it matters: group_hint phone-tiers; prereq_hint sec03-F27; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec03-F27, sec03-F29.
Source: [A15 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0015]
FACT_ID: sec03-R05 | anchor: A15
A car halted by traffic or signals still counts as operating for the phone ban, while a car parked safely roadside frees the driver to call. [A15]
Why it matters: group_hint stopped-vs-parked; prereq_hint sec03-F27; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec03-F27, sec03-F28.
Source: [A15 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0015]
FACT_ID: sec03-R06 | anchor: A15
Emergency calls to responders and clinics stay legal at any age, yet a teen social call draws a moving violation, a suspension on conviction, and a retraining mark. [A15]
Why it matters: group_hint phone-penalty; prereq_hint sec03-F28; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec03-F28, sec03-F29.
Source: [A15 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0015]
FACT_ID: sec03-R07 | anchor: A13
In the penny test, having any part of Lincoln's head covered by tread shows safe tread depth, whereas tread below that mark means road grip in adverse conditions is sharply reduced [A13].
Why it matters: group_hint penny-test; prereq_hint sec03-F04; difficulty_hint 1; confusable_with sec03-F04, sec03-F05.
Source: [A13 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0013]
FACT_ID: sec03-R08 | anchor: A15
An insurance lapse first buys a warning with a compliance pact and fine, but ignoring that notice kills the registration and grounds the car. [A15]
Why it matters: group_hint insurance-ladder; prereq_hint sec03-F30; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec03-F30.
Source: [A15 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0015]
FACT_ID: sec03-R09 | anchor: A14
Driver and passenger belt tickets land separately: each bare occupant earns a personal citation and fine rather than one shared ticket. [A14]
Why it matters: group_hint separate-citations; prereq_hint sec03-F18; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec03-F18, sec03-F22.
Source: [A14 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0014]
FACT_ID: sec03-R10 | anchor: A15
Short trip myths die on two numbers: deaths cluster within twenty five miles of home, and a twenty five mile per hour crash hits like a wall or a three story fall. [A15]
Why it matters: group_hint myth-numbers; prereq_hint sec03-F24; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec03-F24, sec03-F26.
Source: [A15 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0015]
